item.title: Tuesday 10 November: UniCredit, Credit Agricole, Anthropic IPO
item.description: UniCredit posts a record quarter and eyes Commerzbank control, Credit Agricole proposes merging its Italian unit into Banco BPM, and Anthropic's IPO roadshow nears as Hong Kong listings cool.
item.itunes:summary: UniCredit posts a record quarter and eyes Commerzbank control, Credit Agricole proposes merging its Italian unit into Banco BPM, and Anthropic's IPO roadshow nears as Hong Kong listings cool.

item.title: Monday 9 November: UniCredit, France, AI loans
item.description: UniCredit's Commerzbank bid faces a Brussels deadline on 16 November, France's 2027 budget was rejected, and ING is shopping data-centre loans as AI debt reprices.
item.itunes:summary: UniCredit's Commerzbank bid faces a Brussels deadline on 16 November, France's 2027 budget was rejected, and ING is shopping data-centre loans as AI debt reprices.

item.title: Friday 6 November: AI Rout Hits Banks
item.description: Wall Street's worst day since April 2025 on an AI selloff spreads to Asia and AI-linked credit; the Bank of England hikes to 4 percent; Commerzbank posts a record nine months but trims interest income guidance.
item.itunes:summary: Wall Street's worst day since April 2025 on an AI selloff spreads to Asia and AI-linked credit; the Bank of England hikes to 4 percent; Commerzbank posts a record nine months but trims interest income guidance.

item.title: Thursday 5 November: Midterm Rally, France Outlook
item.description: Democrats' midterm win lifted European banks about four and a half percent, Fitch cut the outlooks on BNP Paribas and Credit Agricole to negative with France, and Commerzbank reports with UniCredit cleared to go above thirty percent.

item.title: Wednesday 4 November: Midterms Jolt AI Trade
item.description: Early US midterm results hit the Asian AI trade and pushed Treasury yields lower, Chinese regulators reportedly paused IPO underwriting, and UniCredit's Commerzbank offer closes with a 47.6 percent position ahead of Commerzbank's results.

item.title: Tuesday 03 November: Oil Slump, AI, France
item.description: Brent fell about eight percent on US-Iran talks while the Nasdaq entered a correction over AI worries, French bond spreads stay wide ahead of S&P's review, and UniCredit closes in on Commerzbank before its Thursday results.

item.title: Monday 2 November: AI Selloff Hits Credit
item.description: Tech sell-off puts data-centre loans and private credit in focus, European banks beat Q3 forecasts but shares lag on French risk, and gold slumps 3.5% despite lower yields.

item.title: Friday 30 October: ECB Hold, Lagarde Exit
item.description: The ECB held at 2.5% and signalled a December hike as Lagarde announced an early exit, an AI-spending scare hit Wall Street and Asia with the Kospi down almost 5%, and Societe Generale and ING reported solid results with new buybacks.

item.title: Thursday 29 October: Fed Hike Dissent, French Spread
item.description: The Fed held with two votes for a hike and the ten-year Treasury is above five percent; European banks posted record third-quarter profits but SEB's capital add-on and French debt stress linger; Jio Platforms debuted 27 percent higher in Mumbai.

item.title: Wednesday 28 October: HSBC Miss, French Debt
item.description: HSBC's third-quarter profit jumps 32% to 9.6 billion dollars but revenue misses and bank shares fall, French ten-year yields sit near 5% ahead of the budget vote, and Deutsche Bank reports ahead of tonight's Fed decision.

item.description: Anthropic's public S-1 puts Goldman and Morgan Stanley atop a 22-bank syndicate, HSBC reports a 32% jump in third-quarter profit with a new $1 billion buyback, and Moody's holds France at Aa3 negative, pulling the OAT-Bund spread back.

item.title: Monday 26 October: AI Credit Scare, France
item.description: AI-debt default protection hits records as Citi bridges Nebius, French ten-year yields hover near 5%, and Sweden's regulator adds a second capital add-on to SEB.
